author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at more stunning developments in the reshaping of the Internet. In the UK it seems their are restrictions headed for VPNs to have them require IDs to limit children. I feel it won't end here and it will lead to these VPNs effectively losing any aspect of privacy and forcing them out of giving anything meaningful. We still have a chance to fight back and even if the worst happens let me show you how to circumvent what I believe to be the most futile laws ever. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: The VPN Bans Are Coming...
